eps.o: A family of law enforcement agents investigate a double homicide involving a U.S. Marshal. A mysterious murder hits close to home, forcing the Hollingsworths to focus on protecting each other as a family.

A bank heist turns deadly as the U.S. Marshals and FBI clash to bring down the fugitive, pitting Jane against Clare. Micah adjusts to working for Mike on the Secret Service while hiding a forbidden relationship.

Russ and Clare race the clock to crack a grand jury tampering case. Mike cracks down on Micah's detail. Jane digs for files on the murdered agents, straining her relationships to get ahead of Nia's investigation.
Clare investigates a wedding bomb threat against a cabinet member until Mike takes over. Nia's case leads close to home, forcing some family members to cross lines to protect their secrets.
Clare goes under cover with a new partner; Jane and Nia search for a mole in the Task Force; Russ and Micah unearth new evidence in the Barnes assassination attempt.
Mike hatches a plan to smoke out an assassination suspect; Jane races against the clock to save a hijacked plane.
At the Zenith Ball, Mike tries to prove his theory about the assassination attempt. Clare and Nia work together to stop a terrorist group.
Jane and Russ, following a felon's tip about stashed evidence, wind up in a life-or-death situation. Mike and Micah clash over a scandal involving the First Daughter.
Jane hosts an explosive Thanksgiving for the Hollingsworths. Clare and Raul investigate a homicide between feuding neighbors.
